description: This file defines the QueryParamBuilder class, which is responsible for serializing data structures into query parameters for AWS API requests. It provides methods to format various shape types such as structures, lists, maps, blobs, timestamps, and booleans into query parameter formats.

classes.name: QueryParamBuilder
classes.description: A class that constructs query parameters from API shape data structures, used internally in AWS SDK for PHP to serialize request parameters.

methods.name: queryName
methods.description: Determines the query name for a given shape, considering 'queryName', 'locationName', and 'member.locationName' properties.

methods.name: isFlat
methods.description: Checks if the shape is flattened, which affects serialization format.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Serializes a given structure shape into query parameters.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a value based on the shape's type, delegating to specific format methods.

methods.name: format_structure
methods.description: Serializes a structure shape into query parameters, handling nested members.

methods.name: format_list
methods.description: Serializes a list shape into query parameters, considering whether the list is flat or nested.

methods.name: format_map
methods.description: Serializes a map shape into query parameters, handling key-value pairs.

methods.name: format_blob
methods.description: Encodes binary data into base64 for query parameters.

methods.name: format_timestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp value into a string according to the specified timestamp format.

methods.name: format_boolean
methods.description: Serializes a boolean value into 'true' or 'false' strings.
